citation: Bahety, G., Frijters, P., & Pellegrini, L. (2023). Top Talent, Elite Colleges, and Migration: Evidence from the Indian Institutes of Technology. Journal of Development Economics.
evidence: Identifies IIT premium of 30-50% over admission-marginal non-IIT counterfactual using regression-discontinuity around JEE-Advanced cutoffs; implies ~7-9% annualised wage CAGR over 15 years post-graduation.
notes: Peer-reviewed RD design; addresses selection bias by comparing students just-above/below IIT admission threshold. Anchors elite-CAGR assumption.

citation: Various IIT-B Heritage Fund / IIT-D Foundation / IIT-M alumni reports (2018-2024 compilations).
evidence: Reported IIT graduate trajectory: starting ₹8-15 L → mid-career (5-10y) ₹30-60 L → senior (15y+) ₹50 L-1 Cr. Implies ~8-10% CAGR over 15 years.
notes: Self-reported, selection bias toward successful alumni. Used as triangulation for Bahety estimate.

citation: NASSCOM. (2024). Strategic Review 2024-25: Indian Technology Industry.
evidence: Tech sector average annual hike 9-11% YoY at entry/mid-career (2023-24); IT services mid-career CAGR 7-9% over 5-10 years for top performers.
notes: Industry-wide stat. NIT/IIIT premium below IIT (~75% of IIT CAGR) — NITs feed similar tech/finance pipelines but at slightly lower entry CTC.

citation: AmbitionBox aggregated CTC by experience band (n>50,000 self-reported).
evidence: Indian software engineer CTC by YoE: 0-1y ₹6 L, 2-4y ₹12 L, 5-7y ₹20 L, 8-12y ₹35 L, 13+y ₹50 L+. Implies ~7-8% CAGR for mid-tier engineering.
notes: Self-reported, recency-biased. Captures market signal for NIT/IIIT-equivalent tier.

citation: Docthub. (2024). MBBS Doctor Salary in India: Private and Government 2024.
evidence: Junior Resident govt ₹7.2-10.8 LPA (60-90k/mo); MD/MS specialist ₹10-30 LPA at mid-career (5-10y experience); senior consultant ₹12.5-18.4 LPA typical, up to ₹15-30 LPA.
notes: Captures post-PG specialist track that 7th CPC junior-resident scale misses. CAGR 7% reflects junior res → senior res → specialist progression.

citation: 7th Pay Commission Level 11 pay matrix; AIIMS Specialist/Assistant Professor scales.
evidence: Junior Resident Level 11 ₹56,100-1,77,500/mo (~₹6.7 L start). Senior Resident Level 11 ₹67,700-2,08,700/mo (~₹8.1 L). Specialist/Asst Prof Level 13/14 ₹1.31 L-2.18 L/mo (~₹15.7-26.2 L at senior).
notes: Government pay matrix is the binding floor for govt MBBS career — supplements Docthub aggregate.

citation: PLFS CY2025 unit records; degree bucket = Engineering (NCO codes 03/13).
evidence: Cross-sectional age-band median: 25-29 ₹10.2 L → 30-34 ₹13.2 L → 35-40 ₹16.1 L. Implies CAGR 5.3% — below elite tier because mass engineering has limited mobility / branch ceilings.
notes: Kept on PLFS rate (not elite CAGR) because Top State Eng tier sits below elite-premium threshold (BITS / NIT-adjacent / Anna Univ / Thapar). No academic study supports applying IIT-level CAGR to this tier.

citation: PLFS CY2025 unit records; non-technical graduate + PG group.
evidence: Cross-sectional age-band median: 25-29 ₹2.3 L → 30-34 ₹2.7 L → 35-40 ₹3.6 L. Implies CAGR 3.3%. Reflects general graduate population (mass-graduate counterfactual).
notes: Counterfactual baseline. No upgrade — this IS the population PLFS describes; no academic premium to apply.
